label: PF Backlog 270
title: Hygiene: CI gate (compileall + wired_audit + workflow_matrix_check) on PR
body: Enforce the three checks on every PR (BI-0205 scopes the PR workflow; the gate wiring is still manual).
_note: CI gate: .github/workflows/structure.yml now runs compileall + wired_audit + workflow_matrix_check + backlog E2E + the pipeline/M0 acceptance suite as REQUIRED steps on push(main/develop) and every PR; the broad suite stays optional (system-lib tests).
